scope: Topic 138 decision content - Phú Quốc khi trời mưa. Source-aware Plan B data, not a generic top-list.

topics.title: Phú Quốc khi trời mưa

claims.claim: The official destination portal describes Phú Quốc's rainy season as generally May-October, with rainfall concentrated most strongly around July-September. This is seasonal context, not a forecast for a particular day.

A rainy-day recommendation should be driven by current weather/operational data rather than the seasonal label alone. Seasonal climate context must not be used to claim it is raining now or that rain will persist island-wide.
Cung điện Hải Vương is a covered aquarium experience inside VinWonders Phú Quốc. The operator currently lists it 10:00-18:00 daily and included in VinWonders admission.
Teddy Bear Museum is an indoor museum experience at Grand World. The operator currently lists opening time 10:00-21:00.

Do not label all of VinWonders or Grand World as indoor/rain-proof. Store covered/indoor status at the sub-attraction or experience level because access between zones and many surrounding activities remain outdoors.

Official destination material confirms that traditional fish-sauce production uses dedicated roofed 'nhà thùng' buildings and that some houses accept visitors. A fish-sauce house can be a lower-weather-dependency cultural option only after visitor access and current hours are verified per house.

Open Phu Quoc should not automatically recommend Safari, beaches, cable car, sea tours or an entire theme park merely because the category is popular. Each option needs weather dependency, operating status, access friction and covered_level before Plan B can surface it.

ranking_notes: Prefer verified OPEN + indoor/mostly-covered + reasonable travel time.
Do not infer OPEN from evergreen article content.
Use parent attraction only for navigation; weather suitability belongs to the specific experience.
If current status/hours are stale, show 'check before going' rather than 'good now'.
